headline: Dangerous Dave - the game John Romero made
title: Dangerous Dave Facts | The Classic Computer Lab Game | Classic Games
video_script: Did you play Dangerous Dave in your school computer lab? It is a nineteen eighty eight platform game by John Romero, the same John Romero who later helped make Doom. He made it as an example game for an article in a disk magazine, and it ran on the Apple Two and MS-DOS. Did you play it? Comment below!
description: Dangerous Dave (1988) by John Romero, made for the Apple II and MS-DOS as an example game for a disk-magazine article.
